name: MFCB
recent: Mega First Corporation Berhad 近期公告主要为董事 Goh Nan Kioh 在闭门期间持续增持公司股份，以及大股东 Keen Capital Investments Limited 和 EPF 的股权变动申报。公司最新季度（2026年6月30日）营收环比增长7.8%，但净利润同比下滑29.9%。
notable: 董事 Goh Nan Kioh 在2026年11月3日至19日期间多次增持公司股份。
大股东 Keen Capital Investments Limited 及 EPF 出现股权变动申报。
risks: 董事 Goh Nan Kioh 在闭门期间多次进行股份交易。
最新季度净利润同比下滑29.9%，净利率由20.4%降至18.1%。
earnings: 2026年6月30日季度营收为 MYR 328,721,000，环比增长7.8%，同比下滑3.3%；净利润为 MYR 59,391,000，环比下滑4.7%，同比下滑29.9%；净利率为18.1%，低于上一季度的20.4%。

recent_en: Mega First Corporation Berhad's recent announcements mainly involve Chairman & Executive Director Goh Nan Kioh's continued acquisitions of shares during the closed period, along with shareholding change filings by substantial shareholder Keen Capital Investments Limited and EPF. In the latest quarter (30 June 2026), revenue rose 7.8% QoQ but net profit fell 29.9% YoY.
notable_en: Director Goh Nan Kioh acquired shares in the company multiple times between 3 and 19 November 2026.
Substantial shareholder Keen Capital Investments Limited and EPF filed shareholding changes.
risks_en: Director Goh Nan Kioh conducted multiple share dealings during the closed period.
Latest quarter net profit fell 29.9% YoY, with net margin declining from 20.4% to 18.1%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 328,721,000, up 7.8% QoQ but down 3.3% YoY; net income was MYR 59,391,000, down 4.7% QoQ and 29.9% YoY; net margin was 18.1%, lower than 20.4% in the previous quarter.
